text: Tunde's daughter Efua starts reception on September 4th. He sounded more nervous than she did. Remind me to text him that morning.

Ava is learning to crochet and has already made three hats, one for each of her nieces. She wants to try a blanket next but is nervous about the bigger pattern. She follows a woman on YouTube who does all the tutorials, and she goes to a craft group at the library on Tuesday evenings. Her favourite yarn shop is closing down, which she is gutted about.
Chris finally got his results: a 2:1 in Economics. Graduation is July 18th at 11am. I should send a card before then.
Lunch with Mai on Thursday at 1pm, the usual place near her office.

Kai supports Leeds United and has had a season ticket with his dad since he was eight. They go to every home game and drive up for a few away ones too. He still hasn't got over the play-off final, so never mention it. His dad turns 70 on March 15th, and Kai is trying to get the club to put a message on the big screen.
Farid and Dalia are coming over for dinner on Saturday at 7. Dalia is vegetarian, Farid eats anything.
Varun's son Idris has his driving test on 11/3 at 9:40am. He has failed it twice already and is really anxious about it. Need to message Varun the night before.
Call Grandma Sunday afternoon.
Chidi plays bass in a covers band called The Late Shift. They have a gig at the Crown on October 31st, so I'm going with Mateo.
Mateo mentioned that his partner Camila got into the master's program at Edinburgh. She starts in January. Must congratulate her when I see them.
Pick up the frame for the print before Friday.
Sam's birthday is November 9th. He has been talking nonstop about a new pair of climbing shoes, which might be a good shout.
Heather's book club is reading Piranesi this month. She lent me her copy, so I need to return it by the 14th.
Karan said the trip to Lisbon is off because his mum broke her wrist. Check in with him on Monday about how she's doing.
Omar is training for the Manchester half marathon on April 12th. He runs before work every day now, around six in the morning.
Spoke to Deepa about her twins. Anan starts secondary on September 3rd and Ioana is staying back a year at the primary. She thinks it will be fine.

Antoine collects vinyl, mostly old jazz and Afrobeat. He has been hunting for a first pressing of Expensive Shit for ages and checks Discogs every night. His birthday is on the 23rd, so a record token would go down well. He also mentioned a record fair at the Corn Exchange on Saturday, November 7th, from 10am. I should go with him if I'm free, and ask Paolo along too.
Darius's dog Biscuit had an operation on his leg yesterday. Text Darius tomorrow to see how the recovery's going.
Valentina passed her piano grade 8! Distinction as well. Her teacher put her forward for the youth competition on May 22nd.

Coffee with Yosef was nice. He is thinking of quitting his job at the bank to retrain as a primary teacher. Applications close on January 28th and the interviews are in March. His wife is supportive but worried about money with the new baby due in the spring. I said I'd send him the details of my cousin's course and put him in touch with Heather, who did the same switch.
Lachlan and his wife Ioana are flying to Melbourne on December 15th for his brother's wedding. Back on January 6th.
Don't forget to post Eli's parcel tomorrow morning. The post office shuts at 12:30 on Saturdays.

Ravi is really into Formula One this season and stays up for every race, even the ones that start at 4am. He has backed McLaren since he was a kid and has a signed cap on his desk. He and his brother Omar are going to Silverstone on July 5th. I need to remind him to bring my ear defenders back afterwards.
Paolo's daughter graduated from nursing school on June 3rd. I should have sent something. Still worth a card, even late.
Idris has his first ever match for the under-12s on Saturday at 10am. Andile is coaching. Bring the folding chairs.
Tomás is moving to Bristol at the end of the month. His last day at the firm is the 28th, and there are leaving drinks that evening at 6.
Mrs. Nakamura from next door said her grandson starts university next week. She was proud and a bit teary about it.
Heather has been struggling since the breakup with Chris. She is not sleeping and has taken a week off work. I should ring her on Wednesday evening and maybe take her out for lunch at the weekend.
Efua mentioned she wants to learn to knit. Could get her a beginner kit for her birthday on March 2nd.
Gym at 7 tomorrow, then the dentist at 11:15.
Kai Adeyemi, KJ to everyone at the club, has been picked for the county cricket squad. Trials went well apparently.
Mai called. Her dad's surgery has been moved from Tuesday to Friday at 8am. She's going to stay with her parents all week. Remind me to send her a message Thursday night.
Sam and Valentina are hosting a housewarming on 10/24 from 4pm. Bring a plant. Sam said their cat Pickle hides under the bed when people come round.

Watched the match with Farid. He is convinced Arsenal will win the league this year. He also plays five-a-side on Tuesdays and hurt his ankle last week, so he's out for a month. His daughter Camila has her first school football tournament on Sunday at 9am, and he's gutted he can't run the line. Must check how she got on.
Camila's sister Ava had her baby on Saturday morning, a little girl called Rosa. Camila is over the moon. I want to send flowers to Ava this week.
Chidi said his brother Tunde is doing his bar exams on February 19th and 20th. Tunde is barely sleeping. Chidi wants us all to take him out after the second day.
Deepa is making a quilt for her niece's christening on May 14th. Hand stitched, every piece. She showed me the pattern and it looks incredible.
Antoine and Dalia's anniversary is June 21st. Ten years this time. Maybe book them a dinner voucher.
Got a message from Eli. His son Mateo got a place at the music school he auditioned for in March. Start date is September 8th. I need to send them a proper congratulations.
Varun is obsessed with Warhammer at the moment. He paints miniatures most evenings and has a whole shelf of them. His wife Deepa thinks it's hilarious.
Darius's graduation is May 30th at 2pm. His grandparents are flying in from Tehran on the 27th. I'm driving him to the ceremony.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before 12/2.
Yosef said his daughter lost her first tooth yesterday and the tooth fairy forgot. He is going to fix it tonight.

Omar's mum passed away last Thursday. The funeral is on November 5th at 10am at the mosque on Clarence Road. I should call him before then and ask if they need anything. Also tell Ravi, as he hasn't heard yet.

Paolo plays chess online every night and is rated about 1800. He wants to try a proper over-the-board tournament this spring and found one in Leicester on April 18th. He is nervous because he has never played with a clock in real life. His son Eli plays as well, and is better than him, which he hates admitting. Maybe we could have a practice game one evening next week.
Andile mentioned that her son Lachlan, who is seven, has just started swimming lessons on Wednesdays at 4.
Valentina's choir concert on the 12th was cancelled because the hall flooded. They are rescheduling for some time in January.
Remind me to ask Ioana how the interview at the museum went on Monday. She was fairly confident going in.

Long chat with Tomás tonight. His daughter Camila is in her final year of school and has her A-levels starting June 2nd. She wants to study medicine at Glasgow. He is worried because her mocks didn't go well, though she seems surprisingly calm about it all. Her offer depends on three A grades. Results day is August 13th, so I should text Tomás that morning.
Ava and Ravi got engaged in Rome last weekend! Party at her parents' place on Saturday, June 6th at 3pm.
Mateo said Uncle Farid's 60th is on 7/19. The whole family is going to Anglesey for it. Mateo is organising a video of messages from everyone, so I should record mine by July 1st.
Chris is into birdwatching now, of all things. He's been going out to the reservoir every Sunday at dawn with binoculars his wife got him.
Efua's son Kai has his first day at nursery tomorrow morning. She is dreading the drop-off more than he is. Send her a message around lunchtime to check how it went.
Booked the flights for Christmas. Leaving December 20th at 6:15am, back on the 29th.
Heather just texted to say her son passed his driving test. Third time lucky.
Idris is sitting his GCSEs from May 11th until June 19th. His mum Dalia says he is revising every evening but getting stressed. Maybe drop round a care package for him in the first week.
Karan sent a photo of the bookshelf he built for his daughter's room. He is getting really into woodworking. He said next up is a rocking chair for his mum's birthday on April 4th.
Anan's band has a gig on Friday at 9pm at the Brudenell. He plays drums. I said I'd try to come along with Sam and Deepa. Must buy tickets before Wednesday because they always sell out.
Farid wants to borrow the tent for the weekend of August 8th. Drop it round to him the Thursday before, after 6.

Spoke to Chidi Shah's wife, Mai. Chidi has been in hospital since Sunday with pneumonia but should be home by next Tuesday. Their kids are staying with her sister. I must visit him once he's back home, and maybe cook something for them for that weekend. She also mentioned the school play on the 18th, which their youngest is still desperate to be in despite everything.
